text:
Sam: hey team, new spot near Jack London called Manila Munch opened today. thinking group order around 12:30 after standup. menu: https://manila-munch.example/menu
Tova: is it walkable from the office?
Marcus: yep ~6 min. I can swing by pickup if ppl want.
Anika: do they do gluten-free?
Marcus: looks like rice wraps and a tofu adobo marked GF on the menu.
Sophia: i can drive and take 2-3 orders. @Anika does that help?
Anika: yes thanks @Sophia. ill take a pork adobo rice wrap and a small salad.
Sam: i'll consolidate orders and venmo the pickup fee. post choices here.
Marcus: orders so far: 1 veggie pancit, 2 tofu adobo, 1 garlic rice
Sophia: add 2 veg lumpia + 1 small sisig for me
Tova: small pancit and sparkling water for me
Anika: confirmed: 1 pork adobo rice wrap (GF), 1 side salad
Sam: i'll be ~3 min late to standup, hold the order window open. :clock3:
DevExBot: reminder: label lunches with initials and avoid leaving perishable food in conference rooms. :memo:
Marcus: leaving at 12:20 to pick up. everyone okay with that?
Anika: yep thanks so much Marcus!
Sophia: thanks for organizing Sam :thumbsup:
Sam: finalizing now, will post venmo totals in a bit.
